criteria.notes: Campus directory: building, floor, department, room, walking direction and accessibility note per row, with venue identity and paging progress.
Institutional directory-board concept preserved: serif masthead, ruled table, grouped building bands.
Reads as a lobby directory rather than a data grid; building grouping and direction column are domain-specific.
Department names hold the primary role above their floor; direction and accessibility text sit at the metadata floor by design.
Dark-theme and custom-theme scenarios preserve row banding, rule contrast and the accent masthead.
Long-department and portrait-long-essential-field scenarios wrap rather than ellipsize; the direction column clamps its secondary text.
The table fills the plate on every surface; partial-page, single-building and missing-room states remain balanced, and the empty state substitutes a centred notice.
Institution mark and rules render crisply from 600x600 through 1920x1080; no raster media involved.
The ruled institutional directory is structurally distinct from the card and panel examples.
